methodology: Identical benchmark sources, compiled test binaries built with trimpath before timing. Linux temporary fixtures in one Debian Bookworm Docker container, warm filesystem caches. One discarded single-iteration warm-up per variant, then five 500-ms batches each in alternating order. Filter misses exclude setup and archive I/O; all full streams include selection setup, traversal, tar and gzip finalization. See fixture definitions below. Unrelated workstation services remain running; no competing scan, test or build jobs during measured batches. These are local component results, not HTTP, full backup throughput or game capacity benchmarks.
